  APPLICATION OF SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER
  COMPANY FOR AUTHORITY TO AMEND TARIFFS FOR
RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                     SOAH ORDER NO. 4
         GRANTING SECOND MOTION TO EXTEND DEADLINE


       SOAH Order No. 3 granted a request to extend the deadline for parties to
file a joint proposed procedural schedule. On February 13, 2026, Southwestern
Electric Power Company filed a second letter requesting an extension of the
deadline. The motion is GRANTED and the deadline is extended to February 20,
2026.


Signed February 18, 2026


                                    _____________________________
                                    Rachelle Nicolette Robles,
                                    Administrative Law Judge
